claim: A generated pass that sorts or rolls on a region's id reshuffles every sprite whenever the level program is reorganised, so a restructure cannot be told from a redesign. Seeded from where the room is (its outline and floor), the pass is stable under reparenting and changes the moment the room moves.
evidence: projects/blood-city/level/dressing.py; level/fingerprint.py compared compiled maps order-independently (removed from the working tree in the 2026-11-26 consolidation; at commit ea7be12)
projects/blood-city/level/dressing.py:215-223 (seeded from props.place_id, the world outline and floor); bloodmap/same_map.py compares two maps whatever order their records are in.
use: Key pseudo-random choices on a place id or world position; compare a restructure with python -m bloodmap.same_map before.MAP after.MAP, which says whether two maps are the same level whatever order their records are in.
